text:
kevin: Quick sync — SDK PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/542 depends on API change in https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/468. If we merge them independently console and helm will break. Can we do a coordinated handoff tomorrow morning? Prefer 09:30 PT. :wave:

anya: I can block time 09:00-10:30 PT. I’ll shepherd the API PR and create a canary tag.

sam: I’ll review SDK today. FYI it has a minor interface rename in `Client.start()` so console needs update.

tess: I’ll update console PR once SDK is merged. Do we want a feature flag for the runtime path? :thinking:

ci-bot: SDK checks — ubuntu/py3.9 ✔, lint ✖ (prettier errors). See https://ci.redwood/1234

sam: fixing lint now, should be done in ~30m.

ci-bot: SDK checks — lint ✔, all green ✅

deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for tag `sdk-542-api-468-canary` after merge.

kevin: Proposed sequence:
1) Merge API PR -> create `api-468-canary` tag
2) Merge SDK PR with the new tag hardcoded in `sdk/manifest` (or wire in env var)
3) Console PR updates client import and toggles feature flag off by default
4) Helm chart bump for runtime image and values
5) Staging smoke, then rollout at 10:30 PT if smoke passes

kevin: Approvals needed: @anya (api), @sam (sdk), @tess (console), @runtime-oncall (helm). Pls react with :thumbsup: if you can approve by 08:45 PT.

anya: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup: — will merge SDK after CI and sanity run

tess: Can we delay helm bump until after console merges? prefer separate PR for chart to reduce blast radius.

kevin: Yep, separate chart PR makes sense. sam — after you merge, please create a release tag and ping deploy-bot.

sam: done — created tag `sdk-542-rc1` and pushed. CI: https://ci.redwood/1234/build/22

deploy-bot: staging deploy started for `sdk-542-rc1` -> `staging-cluster`

kevin: Thanks all. I’ll post postmortem thread if anything flares during canary. If any blocker, @kevin (me) will coordinate rollback.

anya: noted. I’ll hold off final production tag until you confirm smoke.

sam: quick note — runtime unit tests show a flake in kvcache tests, but it's unrelated to interface rename. Opening small fix PR now.

tess: good call — ping me once console PR is up, I’ll smoke test locally.
